elements.name: Gnomeregan Engineering Device
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with Gnomeregan

You can request a complicated engineering device from the leaders of Gnomeregan before you undertake a quest on their behalf. You receive a mechanical device that functions as a Wand of Wonder, but it can't regain charges, and it explodes dramatically but harmlessly when its last charge is expended. The device doesn't require Attunement, but it functions only for you.
